verdict.rationale: cubic's docs describe PR diff review, CLI review (`cubic review`), MCP server for coding agents, and an 'Add to AI chat' feature for selecting code as context, but none of this evidence mentions a JetBrains IDE plugin or JetBrains-specific integration — the 'chat' and diff features described are tied to PR/CLI/agent workflows, not a JetBrains extension. missing for 10: any mention of a JetBrains plugin, in-IDE diff viewer, or JetBrains-specific 'Add to AI chat' UI.
